observations: A portable gaming console with a tablet-like screen and two white/grey game controllers attached.
The screen displays the PlayStation logo and a prompt to 'unlock, press the PS button'.
The controllers feature the PlayStation DualSense logo and button layout.
The console is held by a person in a retail or electronics shop environment.
The image contains a watermark for 'MOBILELINKS GADGETS & COMS'.
No brand name or model number is visible on the device in the photos.

claims.evidence: The brand name is not visible in the photos.
The console is powered on but no games are visible on the screen.
The console is shown powered on, but internal functionality and game presence are unverified.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a hardware fault.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The screen may be cracked or have dead pixels.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the screen while the console is powered on.

risks.risk: The controllers may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controllers being used to navigate menus or play a game.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'PSN Status' screen showing the console is online.

response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
